title: Hero sequences — generate and review one complete action group at a time
notes: Planned groups are production targets. Records below identify actual downloaded draft files; their presence does not establish group or animation approval.
Generate the entire action group first. Use single-frame generation or repair only after a group attempt fails its review.
New coherent hero groups belong to this batch; all older batch09 candidates, rejected poses and originals remain preserved.
Keep actual downloaded originals and later derived extraction/registration files as distinct versioned records with source hashes. Never invent undelivered frame records.
Review identity, shared logical canvas, fixed ground anchor, source-to-world scale, foot contacts, local motion, loop continuity and complete group count before any animation approval.
No runtime selection or renderer change is implied by this manifest. Individual frames or a numbered sprite sheet alone do not prove a complete animation.
